findings.what: A waiting patient who already holds a pending offer is skipped, so the freed slot may go to the second patient instead of the first in the queue
Passing an expired offer to the next patient depends on a 5-minute cron sweep, so handoff can lag up to ~5 min after the 30-min expiry
Unique index covers only exact (doctor,start_time); overlapping appointments with different durations and different starts rely on a read-then-write check under concurrency
Duplicate waitlist check is read-then-insert with no unique constraint; concurrent submissions can create duplicate entries
Recording leave does not clear or notify existing waitlist entries for that doctor on the leave dates
Cron authorization helper duplicated from the reminders route instead of shared
